# OpenMoji curated Studio collection

- Upstream: https://github.com/hfg-gmuend/openmoji
- Pinned revision: aeb8bb3a59e2de39c754ac79180c8131c906acea
- Selection: 527 standard color SVGs from animals and nature, food and drink, activities, travel and places, objects, symbols, people and expressive symbols. Skin-tone variants and flags are excluded.
- Per-asset author/date/tags: catalog-selection.json and each bundled SVG.
- Exact license evidence: CC-BY-SA-4.0-LICENSE.txt and UPSTREAM-FAQ.md.
- Original artwork files: source/*.svg; embedded unmodified in the Studio asset registry.
- Suggested attribution: "Emoji artwork by [creator] via OpenMoji. License: CC BY-SA 4.0."
- Commercial use, modification and redistribution are permitted by the license, with attribution and ShareAlike obligations. Studio labels each asset accordingly; designs that adapt/share the artwork must keep CC BY-SA 4.0 terms.
